title: Monetary Penalties on Cooperative Banks
description: RBI imposed monetary penalties on multiple cooperative banks for regulatory non-compliance: Shri Baria Nagarik Sahakari Bank Ltd. (₹1 lakh), Sindhudurg District Central Co-operative Bank (₹13.30 lakh), Mandya District Co-operative Central Bank (₹50,000), and The City Co-operative Bank, Hassan (₹50,000).
